2610.12274.title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
2610.12274.paper_summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.
2610.12274.paper_summary_zh: 文本到 SQL 的模型通常被訓練為將問題直接映射到靜態查詢，而現實世界中的數據庫代理則通過與實時數據庫的有狀態、多輪互動來運作——檢查架構、執行探測查詢、診斷錯誤和修正假設。這造成了一個關鍵的訓練與部署不匹配，因為調解這種互動的執行環境僅在推理時引入。為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了 HarnessSQL，一個原生於執行環境的後訓練框架，能在監督微調和強化學習過程中保留完整的互動結構。HarnessSQL 構建了獨立的、可執行的數據庫環境，配合隱藏的執行預言機，將教師直接推出到目標 SQL 執行環境中，並僅保留經過驗證的軌跡以進行全序列的 SFT，隨後進行執行獎勵的 RL。在 Spider 2.0-SQLite 中，HarnessSQL 顯著提高了緊湊模型的執行準確性，將 Qwen3-8B 從 15.5% 提升至 45.2%，將 Qwen3-14B 從 22.2% 提升至 54.8%，同時有效轉移到如 BIRD-Interact 和 LiveSQLBench 等分佈外的互動基準。我們的研究結果表明，直接在其執行環境中訓練數據庫代理對於掌握複雜的長期數據庫工作流程至關重要。
